resources.string: Saved car hotspot details are used first. Without saved details, DiPlay creates a local 5 GHz hotspot. If that fails, turn on the car hotspot and save its details here.
No car hotspot details saved. DiPlay will create a local 5 GHz hotspot when you connect.
Turn off car Wi-Fi for smoother CarPlay
Background Wi-Fi searches on the car may cause CarPlay audio or video to stutter. Turn off the car WLAN; the hotspot can stay on. Keep Wi-Fi on your iPhone enabled.
Could not create a local hotspot
Open the car hotspot settings and turn on the hotspot, preferably at 5 GHz. Then enter its name and password in DiPlay Settings → Hotspot connection. Saved details will be filled in.
